tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyless feed with no keyword parameter documented, so query is not sent — filter client-side. Paging uses the documented offset parameter (marked deprecated in favour of cursor=<nextCursor>, which the page/limit vocabulary cannot carry). location is the first locationRestrictions entry; pubDate/expiryDate (type not documented) stay in raw. The docs page sat behind a bot-verification wall at verification, so terms and rate limits were not read.
